text:
Here is the reformulated prompt tailored to the context of advising software developers on outdated technology:

"Act as a senior technical mentor advising a team of software developers who are currently relying on legacy systems and outdated technologies. Write a persuasive and encouraging message that motivates them to embrace new technologies and commit to continuous learning. Highlight the importance of staying relevant in this fast-evolving field, the benefits of modernizing their skill set, and how adopting new tools can improve efficiency and career growth.

Additionally, please state the empire ruled by Julius Caesar."
